test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 21 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some vehicles are trucks.

Some vehicles are lorries.

Some trucks are buses.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some vehicles are buses.

(II) Some trucks are lorries.
solution:
**Given **Statements:

Some vehicles are trucks.

Some vehicles are lorries.

Some trucks are buses.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/909c6490bf7a7faf249756e57db9e796dd8e7a1792c3fb52aa066c0e4118d304.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some vehicles are buses: **Does not follow** (Because, Some vehicles are trucks,Some trucks are buses.But the “some trucks” which are buses may or may not be the same trucks which are vehicles.)

(II) Some trucks are lorries: Does not follow (Because, Some vehicles are trucks and Some vehicles are lorries. But trucks and lorries may be different groups of vehicles.So, no definite relation exists between trucks and lorries.)

So, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
